verdict.rationale: MX's docs state that you can download its OpenAPI Specification and import it into Postman [mx-docs-12, mx-docs-26, mx-docs-31]. The official mxenabled/openapi GitHub repository hosts the OpenAPI spec for the MX Platform API [mx-gh-1]. The probe found nothing at the standard well-known paths [mx-probe-2], but that is a discoverability gap rather than a contradiction, since the spec is still published. Missing for 10: a spec served at a conventional auto-discoverable URL (e.g. /openapi.json), and independent hands-on confirmation that the spec is complete and current.
